id: title:fuziontech:enroll onboarding orgs in the trino cell

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Trino compute engine opt-in to warehouse provisioning, allowing PostHog customers to provision Trino cells alongside PostgreSQL, with idempotent provisioning and tests asserting the enrollment behavior.
review.reason: The implementation and relevant checks are visible: P1.F1.H1 adds the Trino opt-in configuration to warehouse provisioning, and P1.F2.H1 adds a test asserting the provisioning behavior. P1.F3.* hunks are snapshot tests and do not demonstrate implementation, so they are excluded. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: Snapshot changes do not independently establish implementation or behavior; tier relies on implementation hunks. No evidence of actual customer adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by snapshot test updates. P1.F3.* hunks are not implementation changes but expected output changes. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are implementation and test, but P1.F3.* hunks do not demonstrate the implementation, only the result. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds Trino compute engine opt-in to warehouse provisioning; the provisioner claims the org into a cell on the next reconcile. Idempotent, so re-provisioning is safe; omitting the key means PG-only, not a disable.
